title: Perry Como and the beard
summary: Como offers to shave Maxwell's beard.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: And then regrew it back in '62. And Perry Como used to come up and look at me every week and he said, 'you still have that silly beard, when are you going to shave it off?' I said, 'when I get tired of it.' 'Why don't you let me shave it off
for you?" Perry used to be a barber. "We could do it on the show." I said, okay. He said, "you don't care?" I said, no. He said, "well, what will you do?" I said, "I'll grow another one."

I'm obliging, I don't care. It's not that big a deal. He said, well, why don't you shave it off. I don't want to shave it off. I'd always wanted a beard. I grew a mustache when I was 19 and then I shave it off once, but my lip had gotten so used to a mustache, taking the skin off my lip made it funny when I played. I figured I'd wait until I was 40, then I'd grow a beard. So that's what I did.
Well, you look magnificent with one, Jimmy.
